memos.argument: Men's cotton knitted pullover with long sleeves and rib-style cuffs/waist is a classic 6110 jersey/pullover; heading 6110 covers jerseys, pullovers, cardigans, waistcoats and similar articles, knitted. CROSS rulings on men's 100% cotton jersey knit pullovers with ribbed neck, long sleeves and cuffs classify them in 6110.20.2065 (men's, 6110.20.20.65-type statistical suffix). Rulings I83145, I86347, K89051, I80024, I80992 and L86635 describe comparable men's pullovers. Weakness: ruling snippets differ on tubular vs rib cuffs, and 6110 vs 6109 turns on fabric/finish facts not given; the 6110.20.20 stat line listing I saw shows 6110.20.20.41 men's (338) rather than a 65 suffix, so the exact 10-digit should be verified.
exclusions_against: Chapter 61 notes could not be fully read (parse error in output); no exclusion seen for 6110
Garments with a T-shirt shape/short sleeves fall in 6109; a V-neck jersey with plain tubular cuffs and hem has no 'rib' trim, favoring a T-shirt reading
Ruling I89898 shows a pullover split between 6109 and 6110 depending on features

memos.argument: Heading 6109 covers T-shirts, singlets, tank tops and similar knitted garments; it has subheading 6109.10.00 of cotton, men's 6109.10.0012 in practice for non-white men's T-shirts. A 100% cotton jersey V-neck knit with tubular cuffs and waist resembles a long-sleeved T-shirt; fine jersey of this kind is how CROSS rulings treat T-shirts (e.g. H86566, I83147). Weakness: 6109 rulings concern short-sleeved crew-neck garments with hemmed sleeves; long sleeves with cuffs favor pullover.
exclusions_against: 6109 rulings cited involve short hemmed sleeves, crew neck; this garment has long sleeves with cuffs
I89898 classified a long-sleeved boys' pullover with rib bottom in 6110.20, not 6109

memos.argument: 6105 covers men's or boys' shirts, knitted. 6105.10.00.10 is men's, cotton. A cotton jersey long-sleeve V-neck top could be argued as a knit shirt. Honest assessment: knit shirts in CROSS normally have a collar, placket or front opening; a pullover without a opening is not a shirt. J80358 shows one men's pullover split to 6105.10.0010 for a feature set I cannot confirm applies.
exclusions_against: Garment has no placket/collar noted; 6110 pullovers rulings were preferred in CROSS for similar items
